name: read_freeness_hodge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['freeness','hodge']:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/('sources/'+n+'.pdf')),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('FILE',n,'TOTAL_CHARS',len(z.stdout));print(z.stdout if n=='freeness' else z.stdout[:17000])
